review:
The Count is a vampire slot set in a castle full of creatures. Blood symbols expand downward into Bloody Wilds when that completes a win, acting as wilds or revealing multipliers of up to 500x. Wild Bats land as wilds or with their own multiplier of up to 500x.

Epic Wild Bats spread their value to every expanded Bloody Wild and other bat on the grid, which is where the big wins come from. The bonuses, from Bat to the Bone to Rest in Pieces, increase bat frequency, and the maximum is 12,500x. Gothic, playful and dangerous all at once.
